classification.difficultyReason: Several linked steps: read seven bars (some between labelled ticks), sum them to 200, sum the two weekend bars to 90, then convert the part-to-whole to 45%. This needs a representation change from graph to numbers to percentage, with no scaffolding.

content.prompt:
The graph below shows the number of visitors to a museum in Canberra each day of one week.

What percentage of the week's visitors came on Saturday or Sunday?

answer.worked:
Read the columns: Monday 15, Tuesday 20, Wednesday 25, Thursday 20, Friday 30, Saturday 50, Sunday 40.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Total}&=15+20+25+20+30+50+40\\&=200\\\text{Weekend}&=50+40\\&=90\\\text{Percentage}&=\frac{90}{200}\times100\%\\&=45\%\end{align*}$$
